description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a compassionate leader to oversee all nursing operations and ensure the highest standards of patient care.

The ideal candidate will be instrumental in fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff, driving clinical excellence, and maintaining regulatory compliance. We are looking to fill this vital role promptly with a professional who is passionate about making a difference in the lives of our residents.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in the state of Iowa
Proven experience in a nursing leadership role, preferably as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing
Experience within a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations and compliance standards
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: $85,000 - $95,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications.
